name: mentor
description: IDE for RDF knowledge graph projects including SPARQL notebooks.

scripts.package: rimraf dist && npm run build:font && node ./build.js --production && vsce package --no-dependencies -o dist/mentor.vsix
scripts.check: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.spec.json --noEmit && npm run lint

untrustedWorkspaces.description: SPARQL endpoint connections and query templates from workspace settings are only applied in trusted workspaces. This prevents an untrusted workspace from directing the extension to make network requests to arbitrary hosts.

viewsWelcome.contents:
Welcome to the Mentor extension for Visual Studio Code! This view shows all RDF files in your current workspace for quick access.

 There are currently no RDF documents in your workspace.

[Create Document](command:mentor.command.createDocument)

[Manage Connections](command:mentor.command.manageSparqlConnections)

Find more information and help at [mentor-vscode.dev](command:mentor.command.openMentorHomepage)

mentor.sparql.listGraphsQuery.title: List Graphs Query
mentor.sparql.listGraphsQuery.description: SPARQL query used to retrieve all named graphs and the default graph from a store.

mentor.sparql.dropGraphQuery.title: Drop Graph Query
mentor.sparql.dropGraphQuery.description: SPARQL query template used to remove a named graph from a store.

mentor.sparql.describeQueryTemplate.title: Describe Resource Query
mentor.sparql.describeQueryTemplate.description: SPARQL query template used to describe resources command.

mentor.sparql.exportGraphQuery.title: Export Graph Query
mentor.sparql.exportGraphQuery.description: SPARQL query template used to export a named graph as Turtle.

mentor.sparql.countGraphQuery.title: Count Graphs Query
mentor.sparql.countGraphQuery.description: SPARQL query template used to check graph size before export.

mentor.sparql.stores.title: SPARQL Stores
mentor.sparql.stores.description: User- and workspace-defined SPARQL store profiles. Each profile describes a store type: how it controls reasoning (a URL parameter or an inline query pragma) and its default queries. Manage these from the Query > Stores settings section. The built-in store presets (SPARQL Endpoint, Apache Jena Fuseki, RDF4J, QLever) and the in-memory Workspace store are not configurable here.

description.description: Optional free-text description of the store type.

documentationUrl.description: Optional documentation URL shown as an 'open documentation' link in the store list.

isProtected.description: When true, the store cannot be edited or deleted from the settings UI.

inference.description: Reasoning control. Present sub-structures determine how reasoning is toggled; both may be set.

supported.description: Whether the store supports toggling reasoning.

enabledByDefault.description: Whether inferred triples are included by default for connections using this store.

urlParameters.description: Query-string fragment appended to the endpoint URL.

enabled.description: Appended when reasoning is on (e.g. infer=true&reasoning=rdfs).

disabled.description: Appended when reasoning is off (e.g. infer=false).

enabled.description: Prepended when reasoning is on (e.g. #pragma reasoning on).

disabled.description: Prepended when reasoning is off (e.g. #pragma reasoning off).

queries.description: Store-specific default query templates; a blank field falls back to the global template.

mentor.sparql.queryTimeout.title: Query Timeout
mentor.sparql.queryTimeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds for SPARQL query execution. Set to 0 for no timeout.

mentor.definitionTree.labelStyle.title: Default Tree Label Style
mentor.definitionTree.labelStyle.description: Set the standard style for rendering of tree labels.
enumDescriptions: Render labels from the annotated label predicates.
Render the URI path element or fragment of the URI.
Render the URI path element or fragment with namespace prefix.

mentor.definitionTree.defaultLayout.title: Default Definitions Tree Layout
mentor.definitionTree.defaultLayout.description: Set the standard style for rendering the definitions tree hierarchy.
enumDescriptions: Group all classes, properties and individuals in the definitions tree under common top level nodes for each type.
Group classes, properties and invdividuals in the definitions tree under seperate nodes for each ontology or concept scheme.

mentor.definitionTree.defaultLanguageTag.title: Default Language
mentor.definitionTree.defaultLanguageTag.description: Set the default language tag to be used for rendering of labels and descriptions in the definitions tree.

mentor.definitionTree.decorateMissingLan.title: Decorate Missing Language Tags
mentor.definitionTree.decorateMissingLan.description: Grey out all terms in the definitions tree that do not have a value which is tagged in the currently selected language.
enumDescriptions: Disable the decoration of missing language tags.
Grey out missing language tags for definitions in all sources.
Grey out missing language tags only for definitions in the active document.

mentor.predicates.label.title: Label Predicates
mentor.predicates.label.description: Manage the predicates to be used for labels in the tree view for classes, properties and individuals. The first matching predicate will be used.

mentor.predicates.description.title: Description Predicates
mentor.predicates.description.description: Manage the predicates to be used for descriptions in the tree view for classes, properties and individuals. The first matching predicate will be used.

mentor.namespaces.title: Namespaces
mentor.namespaces.description: Manage the namespace URIs to be used in vocabularies.

defaultPrefix.description: The default abbreviation to be used for the namespace URI if no other is defined.

mentor.index.useGitIgnore.title: Use .gitignore
mentor.index.useGitIgnore.description: If enabled, the .gitignore file will be used to exclude files and folders from the workspace index.

mentor.index.excludeFiles.title: Excluded Files
mentor.index.excludeFiles.description: Manage a list of glob patterns for files and folders to exclude from the workspace index, e.g. `**/node_modules/**`.

mentor.index.includeFiles.title: Included Files
mentor.index.includeFiles.description: Allows to manage a list of files as glob patterns that should be included in the workspace index even if they exceed the max file size limit.

mentor.index.maxFileSize.title: Max File Size
mentor.index.maxFileSize.description: Files above the specified size (bytes) will not be automatically be indexed at application startup to improve performance. References and definitions in larger files will not be available in the text editors.

mentor.index.diagnoseFiles.title: Diagnose Files
mentor.index.diagnoseFiles.description: Compute syntax and lint diagnostics for all indexed workspace files so the problems panel gives an overview of all issues after an index run. When disabled, only files that are open in an editor are diagnosed, which speeds up workspace indexing. Unrelated to SHACL validation.

mentor.editor.codeLensEnabled.title: Enable Code Lenses
mentor.editor.codeLensEnabled.description: If enabled, the editor will show the number of total references and other metrics for each subject in a document.

mentor.prefixes.queryParameterName.title: Query Parameter Name
mentor.prefixes.queryParameterName.description: Name of the query parameter that is appended to URIs that already contain a fragment identifier (e.g. vscode-notebook-cell) when generating workspace: URIs.

mentor.prefixes.autoDefinePrefixes.title: Auto Define Namespaces
mentor.prefixes.autoDefinePrefixes.description: If enabled, the extension will automatically declare namespaces in the document header. The namespaces that are defined in workspace documents are used in preference over the ones retrieved from prefix.cc.

mentor.prefixes.prefixDefinitionMode.title: Prefix Definition Mode
mentor.prefixes.prefixDefinitionMode.description: Set the way prefixes are automatically defined in the document header.
enumDescriptions: Append new prefixes to the end of the prefix definition list in the document header.
Maintain an alphabetical order of prefixes in the document header.

mentor.sorting.typeSortingOptions.title: Type Sorting Options
mentor.sorting.typeSortingOptions.description: Options for the priority-based sort strategy used when sorting documents by type. See the Mentor serializer [documentation](https://github.com/faubulous/mentor-rdf-serializers/blob/main/docs/sorting.md#priority) for reference.

typeOrder.description: RDF type IRIs in priority order. Resources of the first listed type appear first in the document.

predicateOrder.description: Predicate IRIs in priority order for secondary sorting within each type group.

unmatchedPosition.description: Where to place resources that do not match any type in typeOrder.

unmatchedSort.description: How to sort resources that do not match any type in typeOrder.

mentor.shacl.validation.title: SHACL Validation Configuration
mentor.shacl.validation.description: Named, self-contained SHACL validation profiles. Each profile bundles a set of shape graphs with the workspace paths it applies to; the shapes of all profiles matching a document are combined.

profiles.description: Named SHACL validation profiles keyed by a stable identifier. The key is auto-generated from the name when a profile is created via the settings UI (slugified, disambiguated with a numeric suffix on collision) and never changes on rename.

name.description: Display name. Falls back to the profile's key when omitted.

shapes.description: SHACL shape graphs, referenced by graph URI. Workspace files are addressed by their canonical 'workspace:///' URI, user shape files by their 'user:///' URI, built-in vocabulary graphs by their namespace URI (e.g. 'http://www.w3.org/ns/shacl#').

includeFiles.description: Workspace-relative paths this profile applies to: glob patterns (e.g. 'ontologies/*' or '**/*.ttl') or exact file paths (e.g. 'models/data.ttl'). Entries whose last segment has no file extension automatically match only the currently-recognized RDF file extensions. A '#<cell-slug>' suffix (itself glob-capable) targets specific notebook cells.

excludeFiles.description: Workspace-relative paths excluded from the profile, in the same pattern form as 'includeFiles'.

description.description: Optional human-readable description of the profile.

validateOnStartup.description: Automatically validate this profile's matched files after the workspace finishes indexing.

validateOnChange.description: Automatically re-validate a matched document against this profile as you edit, once it is free of syntax errors.

mentor.files.title: User Files
mentor.files.description: User-scoped virtual files stored in the settings and addressed as 'user:///<path>'. Each key is a slash-delimited virtual path (e.g. 'shapes/my-shapes.ttl'); nested folders are derived from the path. Managed by Mentor (e.g. SHACL shapes created from the validation profile editor); the content is stored gzip-compressed and synced via Settings Sync.

encoding.description: How the content is encoded. Mentor always writes 'gzip+base64'; 'plain' is tolerated for hand-edited entries.

content.description: The file content, encoded as declared by 'encoding'.

id.description: Stable id of the referencing workspace (its 'mentor.workspaceId').

name.description: Last-seen display name of the referencing workspace.

references.description: Managed by Mentor: workspaces whose validation profiles reference this file. Used to protect the file from being offered for deletion in other workspaces.

mentor.workspaceId.title: Workspace Id
mentor.workspaceId.description: A stable, Mentor-generated identifier for this workspace, stored in the workspace settings. Used to record which workspaces reference user shape files so they are not deleted by accident. Generated automatically; you normally don't need to edit this.

mentor.shacl.enabled.title: Enable SHACL Validation
mentor.shacl.enabled.description: If enabled, Mentor will show the titlebar validate button and editor code lenses.

mentor.shacl.maxGraphSize.title: Maximum Validation Graph Size
mentor.shacl.maxGraphSize.description: Skip automatic SHACL validation for documents whose data graph exceeds this many triples. Very large graphs (e.g. imported vocabularies) can take a long time to validate and would otherwise block the editor. Explicit validation commands ignore this limit. Set to 0 to disable the limit.

mentor.shacl.shapesFolder.title: Shapes Folder
mentor.shacl.shapesFolder.description: Workspace-relative folder where a copy of the built-in SHACL shapes is written when a validation profile is created from a template. Keeping the shapes in the workspace freezes them against future changes to Mentor's bundled shapes and lets you edit and version-control them.

mentor.formatting.common.maxLineWidth.title: Max Line Width
mentor.formatting.common.maxLineWidth.description: Maximum line width before the formatter wraps long lines in RDF and SPARQL documents. Set to 0 to disable wrapping.

mentor.formatting.common.spaceBeforePunc.title: Space Before Punctuation
mentor.formatting.common.spaceBeforePunc.description: Insert a space before statement-ending punctuation characters (. ; ,) in RDF and SPARQL documents.

mentor.formatting.common.blankLinesBetwe.title: Blank Lines Between Subjects
mentor.formatting.common.blankLinesBetwe.description: Insert a blank line between each top-level subject block in RDF and SPARQL documents.

mentor.formatting.turtle.maxLineWidth.title: Turtle: Max Line Width
mentor.formatting.turtle.maxLineWidth.description: Overrides Formatting: Max Line Width for Turtle, TriG and N3 documents. When unset, the common value is used.

mentor.formatting.turtle.spaceBeforePunc.title: Turtle: Space Before Punctuation
mentor.formatting.turtle.spaceBeforePunc.description: Overrides Formatting: Space Before Punctuation for Turtle, TriG and N3 documents. When unset, the common value is used.

mentor.formatting.turtle.blankLinesBetwe.title: Turtle: Blank Lines Between Subjects
mentor.formatting.turtle.blankLinesBetwe.description: Overrides Formatting: Blank Lines Between Subjects for Turtle, TriG and N3 documents. When unset, the common value is used.

mentor.formatting.sparql.maxLineWidth.title: SPARQL: Max Line Width
mentor.formatting.sparql.maxLineWidth.description: Overrides Formatting: Max Line Width for SPARQL documents. When unset, the common value is used.

mentor.formatting.sparql.spaceBeforePunc.title: SPARQL: Space Before Punctuation
mentor.formatting.sparql.spaceBeforePunc.description: Overrides Formatting: Space Before Punctuation for SPARQL documents. When unset, the common value is used.

mentor.formatting.sparql.blankLinesBetwe.title: SPARQL: Blank Lines Between Subjects
mentor.formatting.sparql.blankLinesBetwe.description: Overrides Formatting: Blank Lines Between Subjects for SPARQL documents. When unset, the common value is used.

mentor.formatting.sparql.uppercaseKeywor.title: Uppercase Keywords
mentor.formatting.sparql.uppercaseKeywor.description: Format SPARQL keywords (SELECT, WHERE, etc.) in uppercase. When disabled, the original casing is preserved.

mentor.formatting.sparql.alignPatterns.title: Align Patterns
mentor.formatting.sparql.alignPatterns.description: Align triple patterns in the WHERE clause.

mentor.formatting.sparql.sameBraceLine.title: Opening Brace on Same Line
mentor.formatting.sparql.sameBraceLine.description: Place opening braces on the same line as SPARQL keywords.

mentor.formatting.sparql.separateClauses.title: Separate Clauses
mentor.formatting.sparql.separateClauses.description: Insert blank lines between major SPARQL clauses (SELECT, WHERE, etc.).

mentor.linting.enabled.title: Enable Linting
mentor.linting.enabled.description: If enabled, the extension will provide linting for RDF documents.

mentor.linting.unresolvedReferenceSeveri.title: Severity: Unresolved References
mentor.linting.unresolvedReferenceSeveri.description: The severity level for unresolved references in RDF documents.
enumDescriptions: Unresolved references will be treated as errors.
Unresolved references will be treated as warnings.
Unresolved references will be treated as information messages.
Unresolved references will be treated as hints.
Unresolved references will not be reported.

mentor.linting.unresolvedWorkspaceGraphS.title: Severity: Unresolved Workspace Graphs
mentor.linting.unresolvedWorkspaceGraphS.description: The severity level for workspace: URI references that do not resolve to a known graph in the store.
enumDescriptions: Unresolved workspace graphs will be treated as errors.
Unresolved workspace graphs will be treated as warnings.
Unresolved workspace graphs will be treated as information messages.
Unresolved workspace graphs will be treated as hints.
Unresolved workspace graphs will not be reported.

mentor.language.sparql.defaultDocumentTe.title: Default SPARQL Document Template
mentor.language.sparql.defaultDocumentTe.description: The default SPARQL document template to be used when creating a new SPARQL document.

mentor.language.sparql.documentQueryTemp.title: Default Query Template
mentor.language.sparql.documentQueryTemp.description: SPARQL query template used when creating a query for an RDF document.

mentor.language.turtle.defaultDocumentTe.title: Default Turtle Document Template
mentor.language.turtle.defaultDocumentTe.description: The default Turtle document template to be used when creating a new Turtle document.

mentor.language.trig.defaultDocumentTemp.title: Default TriG Document Template
mentor.language.trig.defaultDocumentTemp.description: The default TriG document template to be used when creating a new TriG document.

mentor.language.n3.defaultDocumentTempla.title: Default N3 Document Template
mentor.language.n3.defaultDocumentTempla.description: The default N3 document template to be used when creating a new N3 document.

mentor.language.ntriples.defaultDocument.title: Default N-Triples Document Template
mentor.language.ntriples.defaultDocument.description: The default N-Triples document template to be used when creating a new N-Triples document.

mentor.language.nquads.defaultDocumentTe.title: Default N-Quads Document Template
mentor.language.nquads.defaultDocumentTe.description: The default N-Quads document template to be used when creating a new N-Quads document.
